_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. This ledger used to carry 71 pre-existing lock-scope findings (a module lock held across a filesystem scan, a store write, a provider call or an event-bus dispatch). Every one of them has since been FIXED in place — the scan/write/publish was hoisted out of the locked scope, or the helper was split into a lock-held build and a lock-free write (BuildStoreJsonLocked/CommitStore, ScanUnlocked/Scan, CanonicalKey/MatchKey, OpenLocked's read-then-publish, Persist's take-the-lock-itself, the deferred-event loops in AdaptiveRuntime/BroadcastEngine/ProductionEngine/RecordingEngine, and the narrowed scopes in DisplayEngine/LiveOutputController). The handful that could not be restructured without reintroducing a documented crash (the live-output lifecycle gate) carry a `lock-ok:` waiver with its reason on the line instead. Anything NOT in this file fails the build: a new lock held across a blocking call is a new bug, and there is no allowance left for it.
